stats.text:
You have a limited well of physical and mental stamina that you can draw on. As a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}, you can use it to regain {ref:glossary/hit-points} equal to 1d10 plus your Fighter level.

You can use this feature twice. You regain one expended use when you finish a {ref:glossary/short-rest}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {ref:glossary/long-rest}.

When you reach certain Fighter levels, you gain more uses of this feature, as shown in the Second Wind column of the Fighter Features table.
